query_selection: first 20 numeric IDs in each official train/test qrels split; selected before model scoring
dense_input: title plus full abstract; pinned tokenizer truncates at 256 tokens
reranker_input: query and title plus full abstract; pinned pair limit 512 tokens
selection_policy: No parameter tuning from test scores. Further tuning needs a new untouched holdout or explicit reused-test labeling.
